reader: Claude Opus 5.5, research reader with coordinator check
reason: With the prayers in hand five ambiguous letter groups resolve (luer to aduen, s anc to s nostra, a un to a ut, terpr to ter pr, ritui to destitui).
sources: H. A. Wilson, The Gregorian Sacramentary under Charles the Great (HBS 49, 1915), pp. 113, 116-117, https://archive.org/details/gregoriansacrame00cath
K. Mohlberg, Das fränkische Sacramentarium Gelasianum in alamannischer Überlieferung (Codex Sangall. 348) (1918), p. 216, nos. 1405, 1408, https://archive.org/details/dasfrnkischesa00cath
Fragmentarium F-fjvt (Wien, ÖNB, Fragm. 3a), catalogue description, https://fragmentarium.ms/overview/F-fjvt
text:
Source-assisted reading of F-33ow (Wien, ÖNB, Fragm. 3b). All 36 lines were reread on the native images by a research reader with the editions in hand (Wilson, Gregorian Sacramentary, pp. 113, 116-117; Mohlberg, St Gall 348, p. 216). Changed from the image-only reading: recto 4, recto 15, verso 2, verso 3, verso 15. Each line shows 4-6 letters; both ends of every line are cut away. (?) marks an uncertain letter.
